audit.whatIsWrong: Page called Justice Punch 'his dash knockup' with a 'fifteen-second invitation', and called Sylas's E a stun.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7 — an 11-second window at rank 1, not fifteen. Sylas E recast pulls Sylas to the target and applies no stun (mirror audit confirms the direction).
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in (E 11s, W 18s, R 180s) and 'no stun' replaced with the actual failure state: knocked up with both E charges gone.

Both flagged suspectNames — 'Bait Shield of Durand' and 'Bank Hero's Entrance' — are the correct Riot names with a verb in front. False positives.

edits.before: Galio's Shield of Durand taunt combined with his MR means you cannot safely all-in him pre-6 — his W damage reduction eats your Q-W rotation and the taunt sets up a punish if you overcommit.
edits.after: Hijack takes Hero's Entrance and hands you a global engage while Galio waits out a 180-second cooldown on his own — spend it on a live skirmish. His W taunt is 18s, so bait it before you E2 in.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 favour Galio because his MR scaling blunts your AP rotation — short trades hurt less than extended ones, and he can W-taunt through your biggest damage window.
edits.after: At 3 your full kit lands a real chunk, but Shield of Durand's 18-second taunt eats your best window — trade in short rotations while it is down and the lane stays a coin-flip.
